title: Dual impact of EZH1/2-targeted therapy in HTLV-1-associated inflammation: Direct and indirect mechanisms.
snippet: Human T cell leukemia virus type 1 (HTLV-1)-associated inflammation, including uveitis, lacks effective targeted therapies. Here, we investigated whether epigenetic modulation through EZH1/2 inhibition could influence HTLV-1-related ocular inflammation usingco-culture and infection models.
